Shahi tukra ya shahi tukra resipi | haidrabadi dabal ka mitha resipi ki puri jankari photo aur vidiyo ke satha. haidrabadi bhojnon men banne vali yah ek braid dejart resipi hai jise ramzan ke pavan mauke par iphtar resipi ki tarah banaya jata hai. aamtaur par ise shahi tukra bola jata hai lekin ise dabal ka mitha bhi kaha jata hai kyonki ise chashni aur rabri men bhigoya jata hai.
